panels.title: Retention Cohort Heatmap
panels.description: Когорта — дата первого VIEW_STARTED. День N — доля пользователей с любым событием в N-й календарный день после первого просмотра. Незрелые дни отображаются пустыми.

targets.rawSql: SELECT cohort_date AS Cohort, round(maxIf(retention_rate, day_number = 0), 1) AS `Day 0`, if(countIf(day_number = 1) > 0, round(maxIf(retention_rate, day_number = 1), 1), CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(Float64)')) AS `Day 1`, if(countIf(day_number = 2) > 0, round(maxIf(retention_rate, day_number = 2), 1), CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(Float64)')) AS `Day 2`, if(countIf(day_number = 3) > 0, round(maxIf(retention_rate, day_number = 3), 1), CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(Float64)')) AS `Day 3`, if(countIf(day_number = 4) > 0, round(maxIf(retention_rate, day_number = 4), 1), CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(Float64)')) AS `Day 4`, if(countIf(day_number = 5) > 0, round(maxIf(retention_rate, day_number = 5), 1), CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(Float64)')) AS `Day 5`, if(countIf(day_number = 6) > 0, round(maxIf(retention_rate, day_number = 6), 1), CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(Float64)')) AS `Day 6`, if(countIf(day_number = 7) > 0, round(maxIf(retention_rate, day_number = 7), 1), CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(Float64)')) AS `Day 7` FROM retention_cohort FINAL WHERE cohort_date >= today() - 30 GROUP BY cohort_date ORDER BY cohort_date
SELECT toDateTime(metric_date) AS time, metric_value AS value FROM daily_metrics FINAL WHERE metric_name = 'dau' AND metric_date >= today() - 30 ORDER BY time
SELECT toDateTime(metric_date) AS time, metric_value * 100 AS value FROM daily_metrics FINAL WHERE metric_name = 'conversion_rate' AND metric_date >= today() - 30 ORDER BY time
SELECT metric_date, rank, movie_id, views FROM top_movies FINAL WHERE metric_date >= today() - 30 ORDER BY metric_date DESC, rank
SELECT metric_date, device_type, events FROM device_distribution FINAL WHERE metric_date >= today() - 30 ORDER BY metric_date DESC, events DESC
SELECT toDateTime(metric_date) AS time, metric_value AS value FROM daily_metrics FINAL WHERE metric_name = 'avg_watch_time_seconds' AND metric_date >= today() - 30 ORDER BY time
